Demo Dairy Herd Dataset

Source: R/data.R
demo_herd.Rd

A synthetic dairy herd of 200 cows with milk production data, generated using the full VirtualDairyHerdR simulation pipeline. Suitable for general exploration, visualisation, and regression exercises.

Usage

demo_herd

Format

A tibble with 200 rows and 11 columns:

cow_id

Character. Unique cow identifier (e.g. "COW0001").

breed

Character. Breed — Holstein, Friesian, Jersey, or Crossbred.

age

Integer. Age in years.

lactation

Integer. Lactation number (parity), 1–6.

days_in_milk

Integer. Days in milk at snapshot date, 1–305.

milk_kg

Numeric. Daily milk yield in kg.

fat_percent

Numeric. Milk fat percentage.

protein_percent

Numeric. Milk protein percentage.

scc

Integer. Somatic cell count (cells/mL).

synthetic_data

Logical. Always TRUE — flags this as synthetic data.

source

Character. Always "VirtualDairyHerdR".

Source

Generated by VirtualDairyHerdR. See data-raw/generate_demo_data.R.

Details

Generated with:

farm      <- simulate_farm(name = "Greenfield Farm", n_cows = 200, seed = 42)
herd      <- simulate_herd(farm = farm)
demo_herd <- simulate_milk(herd, seed = 42)

Examples

data(demo_herd)
head(demo_herd)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   cow_id  breed      age lactation days_in_milk
#>   <chr>   <chr>    <int>     <int>        <int>
#> 1 COW0001 Holstein     6         5          176
#> 2 COW0002 Friesian     3         2          178
#> 3 COW0003 Holstein     5         4          179
#> 4 COW0004 Friesian     5         4           98
#> 5 COW0005 Holstein     3         2          104
#> 6 COW0006 Jersey       5         4          263
education_summary(demo_herd, by = "breed")
#> # A tibble: 4 × 3
#>   breed     n_cows mean_dim
#>   <chr>      <int>    <dbl>
#> 1 Holstein      49     152.
#> 2 Friesian      24     173.
#> 3 Jersey        18     145.
#> 4 Crossbred      9     207.
